pure-announcement.rationale: A technical architecture overview, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: mcp-stateless-core covers the session/handshake removal specifically; this note's bulk — the host/client/server participant model, the data/transport layer split, the full primitive taxonomy, and notification subscriptions — is not substantively covered by any single existing MCP concept.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Official protocol documentation with reproducible, checkable claims (method names, transport mechanisms, deprecation notices).

durability.rationale: Even the undated entry URL canonicalizes to the dated 2026-07-28 revision, and the page itself documents active internal churn — sampling and logging are marked deprecated as of this very release — so the primitive set it teaches is mid-restructuring rather than settled.

actionability.rationale: It is a landscape tour of participants, layers and primitives with a worked example, and explicitly defers anything actionable to the language-specific SDK docs and the full specification.

atomicity.rationale: Bundles at least four separable ideas — host/client/server topology, the data/transport layer split, the primitive taxonomy with its current deprecations, and the notification/subscription mechanism — under one architecture-overview umbrella.
